summary: Keep all iOS composer drafts within the existing storage budget instead of silently evicting drafts after the twenty-fourth conversation. Show a recovery warning when draft storage is full or unavailable.

replay.detail: Existing drafts are read from the same owner-scoped local storage key. No graph replay is required.

schema.detail: The local draft envelope and owner identity are unchanged. The existing two-mebibyte storage budget now counts encoded UTF-8 bytes.

rules.detail: Draft text remains local to the paired owner and is not included in quality summaries.

compatibility.detail: This app restores every stored draft within the existing byte budget. Older app versions restore or save only the last twenty-four entries; downgrading and saving with an older app can discard additional drafts.

downtime.detail: No service restart or server update is required.

manual.detail: A warning appears in the conversation composer when drafts cannot be saved. Resolve the storage problem or shorten drafts to resume saving; the previous durable draft copy is kept on failure.

recovery.detail: A quota or storage failure preserves in-memory drafts and the previous durable copy. The warning clears after a later save succeeds. Process termination before that successful save can lose unsaved edits.
